name: Saljong
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Saljong organizes farming communities around seed reserves and access to grain during shortages. The movement presses coastal authorities to give inland producers a voice in trade and storage policy. The University register proposes a connection to Vanga Seed Fleet and Federal Harbour Charter. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
